name: Customer Journey Map
tagline: Journey-mapping deck with white space, condensed black titles, pink-to-yellow stage colors, circular touchpoints, and process tables.

palette.description: White analytical canvas with burgundy, magenta, coral, orange, and yellow stage accents.

typography.style: Tight bold condensed headings paired with small operational labels and numbered nodes.

best_for: Customer journey maps, funnel stages, touchpoint audits, service blueprints, and CX workshop outputs.
avoid_for: Image-led storytelling or luxury editorial decks where tables and process diagrams would feel too operational.

source_inspiration.name: Slidesgo Customer Journey Map
source_inspiration.notes: Rebuilt as source-inspired portable HTML/CSS from public visual references; no source asset files are embedded.
